Aslanemperor, born Dana Austin Gray in Granite City, IL, loves the Wheel of time series.  He's read through the entire series 3 times and is currently doing so a fourth time in order to prepare for the new book.  Dana discovered his love of reading in the eigth grade when he had a choice between reading a rather ominously large book or paying attention to a rather boring teacher say stuff he already knew.  He found out that he greatly enjoyed the book and from that point on realized little by little that he had a love of well written literature.  He discovered The Wheel of Time series when he was in 10th grade.  The Librarian told him about it and he's been hooked ever since.

Aslanemperor hangs about all over the internet, Roleplaying and discussing all sorts of topics from whether the current political administration is write for the government to why bunnies seem to copulate so much.  Aslanemperor will be going to DragonCon this year and is trying to decide if he should go as an Aiel warrior or an Asha'man.
